name: reclamation
title: Reclaiming a record readers may hold
summary: A writer publishes new records and retires old ones while readers follow the pointer and read. Retiring at once lets a reader read a reused record, which the kernel makes visible by poisoning it; a hazard pointer per reader lets the writer wait.

controls.name: protection
controls.label: Protection
controls.hint: none: the writer poisons the old record as soon as it has published the new one. hazard pointers: each reader announces the record it reads, and the writer waits until nobody announces the old one.

results.name: poisoned
results.label: Poisoned reads
results.what: reads that found a record the writer had already retired

results.name: waits
results.label: Writer waits
results.what: times the writer found a hazard on the record it wanted to retire

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model of one writer and one reader, with and without a hazard pointer
